steps.expr: (() => { const st=[...document.querySelectorAll('text')].find(t=>t.textContent==='AOD098'); if(!st) return 'not found'; const m=st.transform.baseVal.consolidate().matrix; const b=st.getBBox(); const pt=(x,y)=>({x:+(m.a*x+m.c*y+m.e).toFixed(1), y:+(m.b*x+m.d*y+m.f).toFixed(1)}); const bl=[pt(b.x,0),pt(b.x+b.width,0)]; const d=p=>+Math.hypot(p.x-320,p.y-705).toFixed(1); return JSON.stringify({baselineEnds:bl.map(p=>({...p,rimDist:d(p)})), setArcGone:!document.querySelector('#setArc')}); })()
